rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH is the standout catalyst leader on the tape. Ethereum ETPs have pulled a record ~$5B of net inflows so far in August — surpassing flows into every major US sector ETF category — after a best-in-9-months $365M July. ETH/BTC broke out to a multi-year high (first such move in ~9 years) on sustained ETF demand and whale accumulation. Canonical dashboard proxy was FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-07T11:52:45Z): ETH 1913.32, BTC 64947.01, SOL 73.54, pulled at run time ~2026-08-07T11:55Z.
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1913.32 (canonical live) vs entry 1893.995 for +107.90 (+1.02%) — ETH firmed overnight while BTC was flat. RE-SELECTED ETH as the best risk-adjusted next-24h pick: it owns the strongest active flow catalyst (record August ETP inflows + ETH/BTC breakout) and the cleanest relative strength, up ~1% today vs a flat BTC (~64.9k) and a technically weak SOL (73.5, still below its ~$77 pivot). Wins vs runners-up: BTC is the safe major but drifting with no catalyst edge, and the CLARITY Act Senate vote slipped to September (Thune confirmed no August vote), removing a near-term broad-tape catalyst that would have helped BTC most; SOL has real long-run fundamentals (36%+ of DEX spot volume) but sits in bearish structure below pivot with higher beta and higher stop-out odds. ETH offers the asymmetric setup with a definable stop. 8% major stop keeps payoff asymmetric.
positions.risks: ETH has run hard into the August ETF-flow narrative and is extended; record monthly inflows are an aggregate, not a guarantee of next-24h follow-through, and a risk-off macro turn or ETF-flow cool-off could trigger a sharp mean-reversion. ETH/BTC breakouts can fail and retrace. Hard stop 1760.25 (-8%).
